candidates.london_reversal: Europe/London: prior 00:00 open to 07:00-bar close return divided by prior 60 weekday observations standard deviation (min 40); fade sign if absolute ratio >=1; enter 09:00 open, exit 13:00 open. One hour implementation lag.
candidates.new_york_continuation: America/New_York: same 00:00 to 07:00-bar close signal, follow sign if absolute ratio >=1; enter 09:00 open, exit 13:00 open.
candidates.london_fix_reversal: Europe/London: long USD 14:00 open to 16:00 open, reverse to short USD 16:00 open to 18:00 open. Predetermined calendar rule, no fitted coefficients.

execution: Hourly bar opens are indicative fills, not quotes. Require complete signal bars; fail on missing scheduled execution bars. UTC timestamps provisionally assumed bar starts; validate against 5-minute aggregation. DST converted using IANA zones. Only Mon-Fri.
sizing: Each active pair receives one third of start-of-day NAV in USD notional. Inactive allocation stays cash. No redistributing inactive allocations, no volatility scaling, max scheduled gross 1. All positions flat intraday; mark daily.
cash: Cash interest zero; returns are trading P&L returns on committed capital, not excess Sharpe over a risk-free account. Report return/volatility ratio explicitly; no claim of conventional excess Sharpe.
selection: Rank candidates by development net return/volatility ratio; select one before printing validation results. No direction, time, threshold or pair changes after results.
gate: Selected candidate development ratio >=0.5; validation base ratio >=0.75; validation stress2 mean positive; all three pairs positive validation base P&L; one-sided circular 20-business-day centered bootstrap mean test Bonferroni p<0.05 across 3 candidates. Passing authorizes further research only.
uncertainty: 5000 circular 20-business-day bootstrap samples, seed 20260918; also report 63-day sensitivity; family of 3 only (does not adjust historical project search).
limitations: Hypotheses inspired by published intraday FX patterns, not a claim of novelty
No executable historical bid/ask or broker verification
USD-denominated exact spot P&L including inverse conversion for USD/JPY
Minimum fees make account size material
No spread filter, news filter or parameters tuned after viewing performance
Selected liquid surviving currency pairs; not an unbiased universal FX sample
Macro dates already studied elsewhere; this is new-family historical validation, not pristine market history
